shloka_text: वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे च परमाद्भुते । सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.93.1 ।।
transliteration: vartamāne tathābhūte yajñe ca paramādbhute | saśiṣya ājagāmāśu vālmīkirmunipuṅgavaḥ || 7.93.1 ||
translation: वर्तमाने while going on, तथाभूते being such, यज्ञे in the sacrifice, च and, परमाद्भुते supremely wonderful, सशिष्यः with disciples, आजगाम came, आशु quickly, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.
explanation: While that supremely wonderful sacrifice was thus going on, Valmiki, the foremost among sages, quickly arrived with his disciples.
comments: Valmiki arrives at the sacrifice with his disciples Kusha and Lava and instructs them to sing the whole Ramayana he has composed, twenty cantos a day and sweetly, taking no payment, naming him as their teacher if Rama asks, and singing above all at Rama's gate -- the boys take the charge to heart and pass the night in eager anticipation.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा दिव्यसङ्काशं यज्ञमद्भुतदर्शनम् । एकान्ते ऋषिवाटानां चकार उटजाञ्छुभान् ।। 7.93.2 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā divyasaṅkāśaṃ yajñamadbhutadarśanam | ekānte ṛṣivāṭānāṃ cakāra uṭajāñchubhān || 7.93.2 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दिव्यसङ्काशम् divine-like, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, अद्भुतदर्शनम् wondrous to behold, एकान्ते in a secluded place, ऋषिवाटानाम् of the hermitages of sages, चकार made, उटजान् huts, शुभान् auspicious.
explanation: Having seen the divine-like and wondrous sacrifice, he (Valmiki) constructed auspicious huts in a secluded spot among the hermitages of other sages.

shloka_text: शकटांश्च बहून्पूर्णान्फलमूलैश्च शोभनान् । वाल्मीकिवाटे रुचिरे स्थापयन्नविदूरतः ।। 7.93.3 ।।
transliteration: śakaṭāṃśca bahūnpūrṇānphalamūlaiśca śobhanān | vālmīkivāṭe rucire sthāpayannavidūrataḥ || 7.93.3 ||
translation: शकटान् carts, च and, बहून् many, पूर्णान् full, फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, च and, शोभनान् excellent, वाल्मीकिवाटे in Valmiki's hermitage, रुचिरे charming, स्थापयन् placing, अविदूरतः not far off.
explanation: He also had many carts, full of excellent fruits and roots, placed not far off in his charming hermitage.

shloka_text: आसीत्सुपूजितो राज्ञा मुनिभिश्च महात्मभिः । वाल्मीकिः सुमहातेजा न्यवसत्परमात्मवान् ।। 7.93.4 ।।
transliteration: āsītsupūjito rājñā munibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ | vālmīkiḥ sumahātejā nyavasatparamātmavān || 7.93.4 ||
translation: आसीत् was, सुपूजितः well-honored, राज्ञा by the king, मुनिभिः by sages, च and, महात्मभिः by great-souled ones, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सुमहातेजा of great splendor, न्यवसत् resided, परमात्मवान् self-controlled.
explanation: Valmiki, of great splendor and self-controlled, was greatly honored by the king and the great-souled sages, and thus he resided there.

shloka_text: स शिष्यावब्रवीद्धृष्टौ युवां गत्वा समाहितौ । कृत्स्नं रामायणं काव्यं गायेथां परया मुदा ।। 7.93.5 ।।
transliteration: sa śiṣyāvabravīddhṛṣṭau yuvāṃ gatvā samāhitau | kṛtsnaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ kāvyaṃ gāyethāṃ parayā mudā || 7.93.5 ||
translation: सः He, शिष्यौ to his two disciples, अब्रवीत् said, हृष्टौ delighted, युवाम् you two, गत्वा having gone, समाहितौ concentrated, कृत्स्नम् entire, रामायणम् Ramayana, काव्यम् epic poem, गायेथाम् you two should sing, परया with supreme, मुदा joy.
explanation: Valmiki, delighted, instructed his two disciples to go and sing the entire epic poem of Ramayana with utmost concentration and joy.

shloka_text: ऋषिवाटेषु पुण्येषु ब्राह्मणावसथेषु च । रथ्यासु राजमार्गेषु पार्थिवानां गृहेषु च ।। 7.93.6 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣivāṭeṣu puṇyeṣu brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu ca | rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu pārthivānāṃ gṛheṣu ca || 7.93.6 ||
translation: ऋषिवाटेषु in hermitages of sages, पुण्येषु sacred, ब्राह्मणावसथेषु in abodes of Brahmins, च and, रथ्यासु in streets, राजमार्गेषु in royal highways, पार्थिवानाम् of kings, गृहेषु in houses, च and.
explanation: They were to sing in sacred hermitages of sages, in the homes of Brahmins, in streets, on royal highways, and in the palaces of kings.

shloka_text: रामस्य भवनद्वारि यत्र कर्म च कुर्वते । ऋत्विजामग्रतश्चैव तत्र गेयं विशेषतः ।। 7.93.7 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya bhavanadvāri yatra karma ca kurvate | ṛtvijāmagrataścaiva tatra geyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 7.93.7 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, भवनद्वारि at the palace gate, यत्र where, कर्म rituals, च and, कुर्वते they perform, ऋत्विजाम् of priests, अग्रतः in front, च and, एव indeed, तत्र there, गेयम् it should be sung, विशेषतः especially.
explanation: They should sing especially at Rama's palace gate, where rituals are performed, and in front of the priests.

shloka_text: इमानि च फलान्यत्र स्वादूनि विविधानि च । जातानि पर्वताग्रेषु चास्वाद्यास्वाद्य गायताम् ।। 7.93.8 ।।
transliteration: imāni ca phalānyatra svādūni vividhāni ca | jātāni parvatāgreṣu cāsvādyāsvādya gāyatām || 7.93.8 ||
translation: इमानि these, च and, फलानि fruits, अत्र here, स्वादूनि delicious, विविधानि various, च and, जातानि grown, पर्वताग्रेषु on mountain peaks, च and, आस्वाद्य having tasted, आस्वाद्य repeatedly tasted, गायताम् let them sing.
explanation: While singing, they should repeatedly taste these various delicious fruits that grow on the mountain peaks.

shloka_text: न यास्यथः श्रमं वत्सौ भक्षयित्वा फलानि वै । मूलानि च सुमृष्टानि नगराद्बहिरास्यथः ।। 7.93.9 ।।
transliteration: na yāsyathaḥ śramaṃ vatsau bhakṣayitvā phalāni vai | mūlāni ca sumṛṣṭāni nagarādbahirāsyathaḥ || 7.93.9 ||
translation: न not, यास्यथः you two will experience, श्रमम् fatigue, वत्सौ O dear children, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, फलानि fruits, वै indeed, मूलानि roots, च and, सुमृष्टानि very clean/delicious, नगरात् from the city, बहिः outside, आस्यथः you two will stay/be.
explanation: O dear children, you two will not experience fatigue by eating fruits and pure roots, and you will stay outside the city.

shloka_text: यदि शब्दापयेद्रामः श्रवणाय महीपतिः । ऋषीणामुपविष्टानां ततो गेयं प्रवर्तताम् ।। 7.93.10 ।।
transliteration: yadi śabdāpayedrāmaḥ śravaṇāya mahīpatiḥ | ṛṣīṇāmupaviṣṭānāṃ tato geyaṃ pravartatām || 7.93.10 ||
translation: यदि if, शब्दापयेत् calls, रामः Rama, श्रवणाय for listening, महीपतिः the king, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, उपविष्टानाम् who are seated, ततः then, गेयम् the song, प्रवर्तताम् let it proceed.
explanation: If King Rama calls for the sages to listen, then the singing should begin.

shloka_text: दिवसे विंशतिः सर्गा गेया मधुरया गिरा । प्रमाणैर्बहुभिस्तत्र यथोद्दिष्टा मया पुरा ।। 7.93.11 ।।
transliteration: divase viṃśatiḥ sargā geyā madhurayā girā | pramāṇairbahubhistatra yathoddiṣṭā mayā purā || 7.93.11 ||
translation: दिवसे in a day, विंशतिः twenty, सर्गाः cantos, गेयाः should be sung, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा voice, प्रमाणैः with measures, बहुभिः many, तत्र there, यथोद्दिष्टाः as instructed, मया by me, पुरा previously.
explanation: Twenty cantos should be sung daily with a sweet voice, using the many meters and measures as I have previously instructed.

shloka_text: लोभश्चापि न कर्तव्यः स्वल्पो ऽपि धनकाङ्क्षया । किं धनेनाश्रमस्थानां फलमूलोपजीविना ।। 7.93.12 ।।
transliteration: lobhaścāpi na kartavyaḥ svalpo 'pi dhanakāṅkṣayā | kiṃ dhanenāśramasthānāṃ phalamūlopajīvinā || 7.93.12 ||
translation: लोभः greed, च and, अपि also, न not, कर्तव्यः should be done, स्वल्पः even a little, अपि even, धनकाङ्क्षया with desire for wealth, किम् what use, धनेन with wealth, आश्रमस्थानाम् for those living in hermitages, फलमूलोपजीविनाम् who subsist on fruits and roots.
explanation: Do not show even a little greed for wealth, for what use is wealth to those who live in hermitages and subsist on fruits and roots?

shloka_text: यदि पृच्छेत्स काकुत्स्थो युवां कस्येति दारकौ । आवां वाल्मीकिशिष्यौ स्वो ब्रूतमेवं नराधिपम् ।। 7.93.13 ।।
transliteration: yadi pṛcchetsa kākutstho yuvāṃ kasyeti dārakau | āvāṃ vālmīkiśiṣyau svo brūtamevaṃ narādhipam || 7.93.13 ||
translation: यदि if, पृच्छेत् asks, सः he, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), युवाम् you two, कस्य whose, इति thus, दारकौ boys, आवाम् we two, वाल्मीकिशिष्यौ disciples of Valmiki, स्वः are, ब्रूतम् say, एवम् thus, नराधिपम् to the king.
explanation: If Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, asks, "Whose boys are you two?", then tell the king, "We are the disciples of Valmiki."

shloka_text: इमास्तन्त्रीः सुमधुराः स्थानं वा ऽपूर्वदर्शनम् । मूर्च्छयित्वा सुमधुरं गायतां विगतज्वरौ ।। 7.93.14 ।।
transliteration: imāstantrīḥ sumadhurāḥ sthānaṃ vā 'pūrvadarśanam | mūrcchayitvā sumadhuraṃ gāyatāṃ vigatajvarau || 7.93.14 ||
translation: इमाः these, तन्त्रीः strings, सुमधुराः very sweet, स्थानम् notes/pitch, वा or, अपूर्वदर्शनम् unprecedented to see/hear, मूर्च्छयित्वा having tuned/harmonized, सुमधुरम् very sweetly, गायतम् sing, विगतज्वरौ free from anxiety.
explanation: Harmonize these very sweet strings or notes in an unprecedented manner, and sing very sweetly, free from any anxiety.

shloka_text: आदिप्रभृति गेयं स्यान्न चावज्ञाय पार्थिवम् । पिता हि सर्वभूतानां राजा भविति धर्मतः ।। 7.93.15 ।।
transliteration: ādiprabhṛti geyaṃ syānna cāvajñāya pārthivam | pitā hi sarvabhūtānāṃ rājā bhaviti dharmataḥ || 7.93.15 ||
translation: आदिप्रभृति from the beginning, गेयं to be sung, स्यात् should be, न not, च and, अवज्ञाय disrespecting, पार्थिवम् the king, पिता father, हि indeed, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, राजा the king, भविति is, धर्मतः by dharma.
explanation: The Ramayana should be sung from the beginning, and the king should not be disrespected, for a king is indeed the father of all beings by virtue of dharma.

shloka_text: तद्युवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समास्थितौ । गायेथां मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् ।। 7.93.16 ।।
transliteration: tadyuvāṃ hṛṣṭamanasau śvaḥ prabhāte samāsthitau | gāyethāṃ madhuraṃ geyaṃ tantrīlayasamanvitam || 7.93.16 ||
translation: तत् therefore, युवां you two, हृष्टमनसौ with joyful minds, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, समास्थितौ having taken your seats, गायेथां you two should sing, मधुरं sweet, गेयं song, तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.
explanation: Therefore, you two, with joyful minds, should take your seats tomorrow morning and sing the sweet song, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.

shloka_text: इति सन्दिश्य बहुशो मुनिः प्राचेतसस्तदा । वाल्मीकिः परमोदारस्तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ।। 7.93.17 ।।
transliteration: iti sandiśya bahuśo muniḥ prācetasastadā | vālmīkiḥ paramodārastūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ || 7.93.17 ||
translation: इति thus, सन्दिश्य having instructed, बहुशः repeatedly, मुनिः the sage, प्राचेतसः son of Prachetas, तदा then, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, परमोदारः most noble, तूष्णीम् silently, आसीत् remained, महायशाः highly renowned.
explanation: Thus, having repeatedly instructed them, the highly renowned and most noble sage Valmiki, son of Prachetas, then remained silent.

shloka_text: सन्दिष्टौ मुनिना तेन तावुभौ मैथिलीसुतौ । तथैव करवावेति निर्जग्मतुररिन्दमौ ।। 7.93.18 ।।
transliteration: sandiṣṭau muninā tena tāvubhau maithilīsutau | tathaiva karavāveti nirjagmaturarindamau || 7.93.18 ||
translation: सन्दिष्टौ having been instructed, मुनिना by the sage, तेन by him, तौ those two, उभौ both, मैथिलीसुतौ sons of Maithili, तथैव just so, करवाव we shall do, इति thus, निर्जग्मतुः they departed, अरिन्दमौ subduers of enemies.
explanation: Having been instructed by that sage, both sons of Maithili, those subduers of enemies, departed, saying, "We shall do just so."

shloka_text: तामद्भुतां तौ हृदये कुमारौ निवेश्य वाणीमृषिभाषितां तदा । समुत्सुकौ तौ सममूषतुर्निशां यथा ऽश्विनौ भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् ।। 7.93.19 ।।
transliteration: tāmadbhutāṃ tau hṛdaye kumārau niveśya vāṇīmṛṣibhāṣitāṃ tadā | samutsukau tau samamūṣaturniśāṃ yathā 'śvinau bhārgavanītisaṃhitām || 7.93.19 ||
translation: ताम् that, अद्भुतां wonderful, तौ those two, हृदये in their hearts, कुमारौ the princes, निवेश्य having placed, वाणीम् words, ऋषिभाषितां spoken by the sage, तदा then, समुत्सुकौ very eager, तौ those two, सममूषतुः they passed, निशां the night, यथा just as, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् (the night) associated with the wisdom of Bhargava.
explanation: Then, those two princes, having fixed those wonderful words spoken by the sage in their hearts, passed the night with great eagerness, just as the Ashvins awaited the wisdom of Bhargava. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 93 ।। Thus ends the ninety-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
